# URLs that check-urls.sh must not fetch.
#
# A skill URL that contains one of these substrings is skipped. It cannot
# fail CI. Use this for placeholders that are not real links.
#
# Do not put a dead documentation page here. Replace the URL.
# Live API hosts that answer but do not serve a browser page belong in
# url-check-endpoints.txt. Those are still connected to. Only a connection
# failure fails there.
#
# One substring per line. Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
# Keep this list tight.

# Sample code uses this reserved host as a URL-parser base. It is not a link.
.invalid
